title: The master hands off instead of compacting
trigger: the master's context crosses the threshold (~60-70% of the window)

steps.text: After a step, the plugin sees the context is over the threshold.
It queues the HANDOFF prompt into the master's session.
The master rewrites its brief: purpose, happened, open, next, ruled out.
Seeing brief_write succeed, the plugin marks the session briefed; when the turn ends it compacts.
Inside the compaction hook the journal first saves a raw excerpt of recent turns.
The plugin runs `coordlite handoff`: the old session row ends with its brief, the next opens.
The CLI builds the boot packet from the store: brief, plan, lint, recent writes, journal backlog, the human's profile, the index.
The plugin replaces OpenCode's summary with the boot packet: same session id and title, so peers still reach it.
On the successor's first step, if the context is still over the threshold, handoffs stop for this session.
